commit.message:
BIP461: add test vectors and reference implementation (#2328)

All vectors were tested against libsecp256k1, and
all verification vectors were checked against OpenSSL.
A check was also added to the `verify` specification
to reject pubkeys with x or y coordinates greater than
or equal to `p`.
